response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior individual contributor with genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators), but the role is a Level II people-management position and the resume shows no formal people management, no direct-report leadership, and no organizational change experience. Mobile exposure is limited to a single iOS/Apple TV stint a decade ago, and there is no evidence of roadmap ownership or team-level strategic planning at the scale this role demands.
strengths: Deep hands-on developer tooling and testing infrastructure work (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD setup, Selenium courses, MCP generators)
18+ years of broad software development experience across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, dojos, and multi-day training courses
concerns: No people management or formal team leadership experience, a hard requirement of the role
No evidence of strategic roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile platform experience is shallow and dated (one iOS/Apple TV role ending in 2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
Limited and dated mobile platform knowledge
